These targets are both involved in the transport of anionic molecules, with the latter being a member of the Solute carrier organic anion transporter family. The evidence indicates that Verapamil may influence the activity of these targets, which in turn could affect the transport of organic anions, including those involved in the transport of the compound (3R,5S,7S)-8-hydroxy-4,4,7-trimethyl-9-(2-methylbutanoyl)-3-prop-1-en-2-yltricyclo[5.3.1.01,5]undec-8-ene-10,11-dione. The scores from the paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, but further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct interaction between Verapamil and Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1.
